_doc: This page's reading of each of the 52 reminders in the five released memory-run traces (judged from the reminder text and the trace around it; not a measurement). recall = brings back something from earlier in the run that the action agent was about to repeat or had left open (a requirement, an environment fact, a failed attempt, an old diagnosis); diagnose = new analysis of what the latest command just printed, usually with a proposed fix; check = a verification or completion nudge (test before finishing, confirm a file exists, the grader will do X).
